summary: Gmail text parts decode with their declared Content-Type charset; ISO-8859-1/US-ASCII/Windows-1252 use the WHATWG Windows-1252 mapping, other labels TextDecoder, and unknown or missing labels fall back to UTF-8.

contract.scope: extractBody (utils/google-mcp-shared.ts) now delegates to extractGmailBodyText, so read, thread and every existing extractBody caller decode with the part charset; HTML link labels use the same decoding
contract.fallback: an explicit decode table is used for the Latin-1 family so the result does not depend on the runtime having legacy TextDecoder encodings (Workers/Bun)
